svg.title: Future Companion
svg.desc: An exhibition piece set in 2075: visitors design an AI companion, talk to it by voice for five minutes and order it, while the app collects research data. 2075 story year; 5 min live voice talk; MIT open source.
svg.text: An exhibition piece set in 2075: visitors design an AI companion, talk to it by
voice for five minutes and order it, while the app collects research data.
